terms.name: Foundations
terms.focus: Argument anatomy, conditional logic, inference questions, and reading-comprehension mapping. Mostly blocked practice.

terms.name: Accuracy
terms.focus: The assumption family, the full flaw library, and wrong-answer taxonomy. Untimed accuracy first; interleaving rises.

terms.name: Speed
terms.focus: Matching questions, timing strategy, sprints, blind review, and Argumentative Writing. Fully interleaved.

terms.name: Mastery
terms.focus: Certify every doctrine at Clerk rank, attack weaknesses with adaptive sets, weekly full examinations.

terms.name: Simulation
terms.focus: Full timed simulations under test conditions, blind review of every exam, taper and test-day readiness.
